topic: My toddler is hyper at bedtime and runs laps around the room
video_title: Toddler hyper at bedtime, running around and not tired?
caption:
My toddler is hyper at bedtime and runs laps around the room. Not tired at all!

For ages 3-6 years: save big running and exercise for earlier in the day, not right before bed.
Screens off an hour before bed, and keep evening light low.
Start a calm wind-down about 30 minutes before sleep.
Sources: AAP, NHS
